<h2 class="module">How the course works <small>the contract, stated once</small></h2>

- **This is a lab.** You write code from session 1, with an AI assistant at your side. You do not need to know Python; you need to be able to judge what the assistant produces.
- **The rule of the course:** anything an AI produced and you submit, you must be able to explain line by line. I will ask.
- **Weekly rhythm:** Monday 09:00–12:00 in Florence. The first 20 minutes are your walkthrough of last week's homework. Notes and homework are published by Tuesday; homework is due Sunday 23:59.
- **Assessment:** a minor applied case brief (40%, after session 5, presented in session 6) and a final AI strategy and prototype portfolio (60%, revision week). Both are assessed on your repository. Details in the [syllabus](syllabus.qmd#assessment).
- **Tools:** Google Colab, GitHub, one chat assistant of your choice, a Google AI Studio key from week 4. Nothing is installed locally. See [Setup](setup.qmd).
- **Nothing confidential goes into an AI tool.** All market, crypto and DeFi activities are educational simulations, not investment advice.
